The training

An immersive, supported pathway

Our Reformer Teacher Training is designed for students who are ready to deepen their understanding of the Pilates Reformer and develop the practical skills, confidence and teaching eye required to guide intelligent, safe and considered classes.

The program begins in October with 4 in-person training days, supported by a complete 100-hour training pathway. Across the training, students explore foundational Reformer repertoire spanning both the Classical Pilates method and Contemporary Reformer practice — studying spring selection, equipment safety, class planning, cueing, modifications, progressions, contraindications, observation skills, and the art of teaching different bodies in a group setting.

It combines in-person learning, online study, observation, self-practice and ongoing mentorship, so students are supported beyond the initial training days and into real teaching experience.

Following the course, you'll be supported through our community class program — where you can go on to teach straight away, gaining the real-world experience and mentorship you need to step into the industry with confidence.

In-person

After the training

Complete at your own pace

— 10 hours of class observation

Start the moment you enrol.

Begin your 30 included Reformer classes as soon as you pay your deposit — building your own practice before, during and after the in-person days. You'll have up to 6 months after the final training day to complete all requirements, with ongoing support from our teaching team throughout.

Learning outcomes

Graduate ready to teach with confidence

Great teachers are created through practice, mentorship and a deep understanding of movement — not simply by learning exercises. You'll develop the knowledge, practical skills and confidence to teach Reformer Pilates with clarity, creativity and integrity.

You'll learn how to

  • Design intelligent, purposeful Reformer classes that flow seamlessly
  • Understand functional anatomy & movement principles to teach with confidence
  • Deliver clear, effective cueing and meaningful hands-on adjustments
  • Adapt exercises for different bodies, abilities and experience levels
  • Develop your own authentic teaching voice
  • Create classes that are challenging, inclusive and genuinely enjoyable
  • Step into the industry with real experience and professional confidence

By the end you'll have more than a certification — you'll have the practical teaching experience, mentorship and foundation to confidently begin your career in boutique studios, wellness spaces or your own classes.

Who it's for

Ready to teach with care

This training is for students ready to take their Reformer practice further and begin the process of becoming a thoughtful, safe and capable Reformer teacher.

It's suited to those who value depth, mentorship, practical experience and a slower, more supported pathway into teaching — not a rushed weekend certification.

Prerequisite: Prior Pilates knowledge is required. Students must have completed a Matwork Teacher Training Certificate before commencing this Reformer training.
Real teaching experience

Our community class program

The training doesn't end in the studio. Through our community class program, you'll step in and teach real Reformer classes — gaining genuine, in-front-of-real-bodies teaching experience while you're still supported by our team.

It's the stepping stone that gets your career going: build confidence, find your teaching voice, and step into the industry with real experience behind you.

Good to know

Frequently asked

Do I need prior experience?

Yes — a completed Matwork Pilates Certification is required before you begin. From there, we take you deep into the Reformer.

When can I start?

As soon as you pay your deposit. You can begin your 30 included Reformer classes right away and build your practice before the in-person days.

How long do I have to complete it?

Up to 6 months after the final in-person training day, with ongoing support from our teaching team throughout.

What can I teach afterwards?

Reformer Pilates in boutique studios, wellness spaces or your own classes across Australia — with real teaching experience already behind you through our community class program.

Where is it held?

Our studios in Palm Beach & Robina on the Gold Coast.
